This synthetic notice is published by Synthetic Appliance Co. for its SX-100 (synthetic) dehumidifier.
The SX-100 (synthetic) is discontinued and is replaced by the SX-200.
Owners who want more capacity can also look at the SX-300 in the same synthetic line.

Care schedule
Clean the bucket filter every 3 months.
Replace the drain hose every 2 years.
The SX-200 lists at $349 in this synthetic notice.
